"[[Ace Squadron (reference book)|Ace Squadron]]" establishes that Yeager is 1.83 [[meter]]s tall, meaning Kev must be around that height. |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes=[[Color|Gold]] |skin=Green |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Resistance]] **[[Jade Squadron]]{{Resistance|Rebuilding the Resistance}} *[[Team Colossus|Team ''Colossus'']] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|The situation's pretty dire. We've been searching the galaxy for anyone willing to fight against the First Order, but some systems would rather surrender than go to war.|Norath Kev, to Kazuda Xiono|audio=NorathKev1-RebuildingTheResistance.flac|}} '''Norath Kev''' was a [[Duros]] [[Gender|male]] from the [[planet]] [[Duro]] who operated as a [[Resistance]] [[spy]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] planet [[Varkana]] alongside his [[BB-series astromech droid|astromech droid]], [[2BR-NTB]]. Kev tracked [[First Order]] activity by monitoring [[black market]] material shipments on the world and gathering a list of First Order sympathizers and collaborators. However, the [[Merchant|vendor]] [[Lechee]] turned the spy in to the First Order in [[34 ABY]], forcing him and his [[Astromech droid|droid]] to flee and activate a [[Distress signal|distress call]]. The [[bounty hunter]] [[Ax Tagrin]] destroyed 2BR-NTB and captured Kev, keeping him aboard his [[Starship|ship]], the ''[[Dalkor Dagger]]''. Resistance operatives [[Kazuda Xiono]] and [[Jarek Yeager]], the [[pirate]] [[Synara San]], and the astromech [[droid]] [[CB-23]] [[Rescue of Norath Kev|traveled]] to Varkana after receiving Kev's distress signal, finding the spy's [[datapad]] and [[data rod]] containing his First Order black market work and keeping a copy of it. Though briefly trapped on the ''Dalkor Dagger'', Kev and his rescuers managed to crash the vessel, with him and Xiono fleeing the scene via [[speeder bike]] while the rest of the group fought Tagrin. The Varkana spy and his newfound colleague worked together to save Yeager, San, and CB-23—whom the [[bounty]] [[Hunting|hunter]] had captured—by [[Thief|stealing]] the [[First Order stormtrooper armor|armor]] of [[Unidentified First Order stormtrooper 1 (Varkana)|two]] [[Unidentified First Order stormtrooper 2 (Varkana)|stormtroopers]] as disguises and freeing them from First Order custody. After another brief skirmish with Tagrin and later with [[TIE/fo space superiority fighter|First Order TIE fighters]], the group's [[Unidentified Star Commuter 2000|shuttle]] successfully fled the [[Varkana system]] and boarded the [[Trantor-class supertanker fuel depot|supertanker fuel depot]] ''[[Colossus]]''. In the time afterward, Kev continued working for the Resistance by accepting a [[blaster]] shipment on the Outer Rim planet [[Mon Cala]] and scheduling a rendezvous with Xiono near the Outer Rim planet [[Batuu]], though the latter had to abandon the meetup when a [[Unidentified Spider probe droid|First Order probe droid]] attacked his [[Fireball|ship]]. As part of the Resistance's [[Jade Squadron]] under the [[Commanding officer|command]] of [[Resistance pilot]] [[Venisa Doza]], Kev traveled to the ''Colossus'' with her and the [[pilot]] [[Hugh Sion]]. The [[squadron]] and three of the ''Colossus''{{'s}} [[ace]] pilots—Xiono, [[Torra Doza]], and [[Hype Fazon]]—traveled to the Outer Rim planet [[Dantooine]] and [[Blockade of Dantooine|attempted]] to escort three [[Resistance shuttle|shuttles]] of Resistance recruits off the world. [[Shuttle two (Resistance)|One]] of the [[shuttle]]s was destroyed despite Kev and Torra's best efforts to protect it, forcing Jade Squadron, the ace pilots, and the two remaining vessels to leave the ship behind and jump to [[hyperspace]]. Not long afterward, Kev flew alongside his squadron during a [[Battle of Barabesh|battle]] in the [[Barabesh system]] and made attack passes on the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Thunderer]]''{{'s}} [[engine]]s. With the assistance of the ''Colossus'' and its [[Ace Squadron]], Jade Squadron defeated the [[Star Destroyer]] and celebrated in the [[cantina]] [[Aunt Z's Tavern]] afterward as part of [[Team Colossus|Team ''Colossus'']]. ==Biography== ===Spying on Varkana=== ====Caught in Vargo Spaceport==== {{Quote|Come on! Oh, we don't have much time.''"
[2BR-NTB beeps]
"''We need to send an open distress call. Anyone using a Resistance frequency should be able to pick it up.|Norath Kev and 2BR-NTB|audio=NorathKev1-TheMissingAgent.flac|}} The [[Duros]] [[Gender|male]] Norath Kev [[Homeworld|hailed]] from the [[planet]]{{Databank|cad-bane|Cad Bane}} [[Duro]] and lived by the [[time]] of the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]]. He operated as a Resistance [[spy]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]][[Star Wars Galaxy Map (poster)|''Star Wars'' Galaxy Map poster]] planet [[Varkana]] alongside his [[BB-series astromech droid|astromech droid]], [[2BR-NTB]]. The pair became familiar with the world on which they were stationed and, at one point, worked in a building within [[Vargo Spaceport]], where Kev kept a secret compartment for his [[datapad]]. For some time, the spy monitored the world's [[black market]] material shipments to track the First Order. He eventually gathered a list of individuals on Varkana working for the First Order as dealers or collaborators. [[File:NorathKevDistressSignal-TheMissingAgent.png|thumb|left|300px|Norath Kev used his datapad to send a Resistance distress signal.]] In [[34 ABY]],{{ResistanceDate|2|12}} the [[Merchant|vendor]] [[Lechee]]—the operator of [[Leechee's Junk Emporium]] and a First Order collaborator—discovered the spy's ties to the Resistance and decided to report him to the First Order. The First Order sent the [[bounty hunter]] [[Ax Tagrin]] after Kev, forcing him and 2BR-NTB to flee through a marketplace to avoid capture. After the pair ascended a set of stairs, they entered a building within Vargo Spaceport, where the spy activated an open [[Distress signal|distress call]] using his [[data rod]] and datapad. Kev explained to his [[Astromech droid|droid]] that the signal could be picked up on any Resistance frequency but acknowledged the [[droid]]'s concerns that it was risky. The Resistance operative quickly put his datapad and data rod in their hiding spot as the sound of steps approached their building, indicating that he and 2BR-NTB should remain quiet. Using his [[Ax Tagrin's vibro-ax|vibro-ax]], Tagrin easily broke open the room's door and held Kev and 2BR-NTB at [[blaster]]-point. Kev claimed he had already activated a distress signal, prompting the [[bounty]] [[Hunting|hunter]] to shoot at 2BR-NTB and [[Death|destroy]] the droid nonchalantly. Kev was saddened by the droid's loss and called out for them before turning to Tagrin and bluffing that many Resistance fighters were on their way to save him. However, the bounty hunter indicated that such an occurrence would be welcome, as each [[prisoner]] would bring him more [[Currency|money]], and he took the spy into custody aboard his [[Starship|ship]], the ''[[Dalkor Dagger]]''.{{Databank|dalkor-dagger|Dalkor Dagger}} Afterward, Lechee was paid a large sum of [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] for turning in Kev to the First Order. ====Rescue attempt==== {{Quote|What does it say?''"
"''The guy we're looking for is named Norath Kev. He came here to spy on the First Order. ''[…]'' He was tracking the First Order by tracing activity in the black market.|Jarek Yeager and Kazuda Xiono, after discovering Norath Kev's datapad|audio=NorathKev2-TheMissingAgent.flac|}} On the [[Trantor-class supertanker fuel depot|supertanker fuel depot]] ''[[Colossus]]'', which was [[Hunt for the Colossus|fleeing]] from the First Order, the Resistance operative [[Kazuda Xiono]] received Kev's distress signal and implored for permission to investigate. Though the ''Colossus''{{'s}} [[captain]], [[Imanuel Doza]], felt wary of it being a trap, Xiono; his''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' astromech droid, [[CB-23]]; the [[pirate]]{{Resistance|Breakout}} Synara San; and his fellow Resistance operative [[Jarek Yeager]] opted to investigate and see if they could help, as the [[Varkana system]] was near their location. After [[Rescue of Norath Kev|landing]] on Varkana, the group made their way to the [[signal beacon]] activated by Kev, unaware Tagrin had captured him. [[File:XionoDiscoversKevDatapad-TheMissingAgent.png|thumb|right|300px|Kazuda Xiono discovered Norath Kev's datapad, which was emitting a distress call.]] With CB-23's help, Xiono recovered Kev's datapad and data rod, learning the spy's identity and that he had been sent to Varkana on the Resistance's behalf to track First Order black market activity. Xiono conversed with Yeager about Kev's work on the planet while CB-23 downloaded the data, with the group intending to depart shortly afterward after realizing that Lechee—whom their group had encountered upon their arrival to the planet—was likely working for the First Order and may have reported their presence on Varkana. However, Tagrin confronted Xiono and his colleagues before they could leave, resulting in a brief skirmish in which Kev's datapad was destroyed. The bounty hunter left and went to his ship, planning to trap the group when they inevitably came to rescue Kev. After discussing, Yeager, San, and Xiono decided that as long as there was a chance Tagrin had captured the Varkana spy alive, they would try to rescue him. Suspecting Lechee had turned the spy in, the group confronted the vendor by threatening to [[Thief|rob]] him until he admitted to having reported Kev to the First Order, indicating that he may have been brought to Tagrin's ship if still alive. ====Aboard Tagrin's ship==== {{Quote|I had a whole list of names. First Order sympathizers and dealers. But that's lost, making my mission a complete failure.''"
"''Don't be so sure about that. CB‐23 has the list.''"
"''What? Whoa, then there's still a chance!|Norath Kev and Kazuda Xiono|audio=NorathKev3-TheMissingAgent.flac|}} [[File:TrappedDalkorDagger-TheMissingAgent.png|thumb|left|300px|Ax Tagrin trapped Norath Kev (second from left) and other Resistance members aboard his ship, intending to deliver them to the First Order.]] Xiono, Yeager, and CB-23 found a dazed Kev in a sealed compartment aboard the bounty hunter's ship and broke his [[Stuncuffs|restraints]]. Though the spy attempted to warn them of the impending trap, Tagrin swiftly locked the group aboard his vessel. Kev apologized for the group getting involved in such a messy situation, explaining the parameters of his original mission and dejectedly reflecting that losing his First Order contacts list meant his endeavor was a failure. However, the spy was thrilled when Xiono informed him that CB-23 had downloaded a copy of the list. Tagrin arranged for the First Order's [[Commander]] [[Pyre]] to pay for the capture of Kev, Xiono, Yeager, and CB-23 and flew to meet at a rendezvous point. Kev insisted they needed to get off the bounty hunter's ship before they met with the First Order, helping Xiono pry open a panel. CB-23 then [[Saboteur|overloaded]] the ship's systems, but when Tagrin activated a countermeasure against their tampering, Xiono and Kev were briefly electrocuted and thrown backward. CB-23's efforts resulted in the ship roughly crashing into Varkana's surface, bouncing its passengers around inside on impact. Kev injured his head and [[Limb|leg]] upon landing, flopping onto the ground after attempting to walk. The spy slowly departed the vessel supported by Xiono, alongside CB-23 and Yeager, walking for a short distance. [[File:NorathAndKazPanicking-TheMissingAgent.png|thumb|right|300px|Kazuda Xiono and Norath Kev panicked when Ax Tagrin threw his vibro-ax at them to stall their escape.]] However, Tagrin spotted the group leaving and fired on them, with Yeager firing back while Xiono and Kev took cover. San—who had followed the group to the crash site on a [[speeder bike]]—arrived and joined the firefight, instructing Xiono to call Captain Doza for an evacuation. Xiono and Kev boarded the pirate's [[speeder]] bike and fled the scene with the latter driving as the bounty hunter threw his [[vibro-ax]] at them. The bounty hunter captured San, Yeager, and CB-23 shortly afterward by activating a powerful ability of his vibro-[[Axe|ax]] that filled the [[Local day|night]] sky with light, leaving Kev and Xiono to wonder what had caused it as they noticed and were unable to contact their colleagues. Xiono called Doza via [[Comm unit|comm]] for an evacuation but was informed that the First Order had already arrived in the [[Star system|system]], causing Kev to agree with Xiono that their [[Standard day|day]] kept getting worse. ====Hiding from pursuers==== {{Quote|So, uh… so what is your plan to rescue everyone and get us out in one piece?''"
"''Yes, right, the plan. Um… Uh, the plan.''"
"''The plan. The plan. You just told Doza you had one, remember? Please tell me you actually have one?''"
"''Of course I do. What, you think I'd get us into this mess without a plan?''"
"''Kaz…|Norath Kev and Kazuda Xiono, discussing their next move|audio=NorathKev1-Breakout.flac|}} [[File:Breakout-EpisodeGuide.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Norath Kev and Kazuda Xiono evaded detection on the streets of Varkana while trying to locate their colleagues.]] While on the outskirts of Vargo Spaceport, Xiono and Kev began planning to help their captured colleagues after spotting them in Tagrin's custody. Kev felt remorseful about having endangered them by sending out his initial distress call, though his companion assured him that the bounty hunter had likely wanted the signal to be issued to lure in more Resistance members. The pair continued to make their way through the [[spaceport]], with Xiono contacting Doza to explain their colleagues' capture and insist they had a plan to get them back. However, after ending the call, he admitted to Kev that he had no plan to free their friends. Kev was frustrated with Xiono's lack of ideas, and as they continued to evade detection in the spaceport, he insisted they could not continue sneaking around indefinitely. Nearby in the spaceport, stormtroopers showed wanted posters for the Resistance operatives to the [[fruit]] vendor [[Darrb]]. Xiono suggested that [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtroopers]] should be their plan, though Kev did not initially understand what he meant until the former explained that they could ambush two [[trooper]]s and steal their [[First Order stormtrooper armor|armor]] to rescue their friends, who had by then been transferred into the First Order's custody. The spy was skeptical of Xiono's plan with the armor and assumed he would need to come up with a new idea instead. As Xiono hastily departed, he tripped over a container that landed on Kev, causing the latter to yell out in pain. [[Unidentified First Order stormtrooper 1 (Varkana)|Two]] [[Unidentified First Order stormtrooper 2 (Varkana)|stormtroopers]] noticed the sound and began firing [[stun]] blasts at the pair, forcing them to flee through Varkana's streets. The pair decided to hide in [[Darrb's house|Darrb's residence]], picking up the [[alien]] and carrying him{{SW|url=news/buckets-list-extra-breakout-star-wars-resistance|text=Bucket's List Extra: 4 Fun Facts from "Breakout" - ''Star Wars Resistance''}} into the building before he could protest. [[File:NorathKazudaDarrb-Breakout.png|thumb|right|300px|Norath Kev and Kazuda Xiono forcibly kept Darrb quiet while hiding in the vendor's residence.]] While Kev held his hands over the vendor's [[mouth]] to prevent him from speaking, Xiono promised they would leave shortly and handed him a piece of [[Foodstuff|produce]]. Darrb struggled to break free in his panic and briefly shouted, causing both Resistance operatives to continue trying to keep him quiet. After the stormtroopers passed by the building's door, Darrb stomped on Kev's foot, causing him to lose his grip and let the vendor run away from them. Following the noise of their scuffle, the pair of stormtroopers demanded to enter the room and broke open the door shortly afterward. The two Resistance operatives quickly positioned Darrb in front of the door and moved out of sight of the door. Upon entering, the troopers found a terrified Darrb standing in front of them, but before they could search the premises, Kev and Xiono used bowls to knock them out. ====A disguised infiltration==== {{Quote|Ah, it's like I said. Trooper disguise. Nice and easy.''"
"''I can't believe we're actually doing this.|Kazuda Xiono and Norath Kev|audio=NorathKev2-Breakout.flac|}} Although the Varkana spy still had misgivings about their plan, he and Xiono dragged the two troopers out of Darrb's residence and stole their [[armor]]. As Kev struggled to fit in the armor properly and complained about its fit, Tagrin tapped into their [[helmet]] [[Comlink|comms]] and listened to their plans to rescue Yeager, San, and CB-23. After learning that Xiono intended to return to their [[Unidentified Star Commuter 2000|shuttle]] with Kev after freeing their other friends, the bounty hunter went to lie in wait for them there. Meanwhile, the two Resistance operatives slowly traveled through Varkana's streets toward a [[hangar]], with Xiono reassuring Kev that their plan would work, even though he had only used a trooper disguise once successfully before. They eventually joined another group of stormtroopers when ordered to fall in with them. As the group traveled, Kev struggled to keep pace with the others due to the awkward, undersized fit of his stolen armor. [[File:XionoKevStunnedPyre-Breakout.png|thumb|left|300px|Kazuda Xiono (left) and Norath Kev (right) after the former stunned Pyre.]] Upon reaching the hangar, the pair broke off from the group of stormtroopers and stopped in front of a doorway to discuss their next move. However, Pyre opened the door behind them and noticed their startled reactions to his presence, asking the pair for their [[Operating number|call numbers]]. Xiono began to reply but quickly stunned the First Order commander and closed the door, much to Kev's surprise. Kev then told the next group of troopers approaching that the entry behind them was malfunctioning, and he felt relieved when they walked away. The duo then made their way to the [[Upsilon-class command shuttle|shuttle]] where Yeager and San were being held and set them free from their [[interrogation chair]]s. Xiono introduced Kev to his colleagues, and the latter briefly struggled to remove his helmet before returning the salutations. CB-23—who had escaped on her{{Resistance|The Escape (episode)}} own—joined them, and Xiono called Doza for an evacuation. However, when there was no reply, Kev questioned if they had left. The group went to their [[Star Commuter 2000|shuttle]] but quickly fled the vessel after Tagrin ambushed them there, locking the bounty hunter inside. ====Escaping Varkana==== {{Quote|Good job yourself, Kaz. This whole trooper disguise plan actually worked.''"
"''Thanks, Norath. Now strap in. We're not in the clear yet.|Norath Kev and Kazuda Xiono, as their shuttle fled Varkana|audio=NorathKev3-Breakout.flac|}} [[File:KazNorathStormtroopers-Breakout.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Norath Kev made it safely aboard the ''Colossus'' with his rescuers and met Neeku Vozo shortly afterward.]] Tagrin used his vibro-ax to escape from the ship and tossed a flash device at the group, who were regrouping not far outside the [[shuttle]], and used their momentary confusion to close the distance between them. However, CB-23 began operating the vessel remotely and used it to knock out Tagrin, allowing Kev and the others to escape Varkana's surface aboard the shuttle. Now safely aboard, he congratulated Xiono on the trooper disguise plan's success, having been initially skeptical. Kev remained by Xiono's side as the ship gained altitude and evaded [[TIE/fo space superiority fighter|First Order TIE fighters]] with the help of the ''Colossus''{{'s}} [[Ace Squadron]] [[pilot]]s, who had come to assist them. Kev was surprised by their arrival, not recognizing the pilots, and was shocked when the ''Colossus'' arrived to rescue them. After Xiono and Ace Squadron landed aboard the [[supertanker fuel depot]], the Varkana spy thanked Doza for the rescue on the Resistance's behalf. Afterward, Kev helped Xiono explain that their stormtrooper armor was part of a disguise tactic to the latter's friend, the [[Technician|mechanic]] [[Neeku Vozo]]. Kev also offered for Xiono to depart the ''Colossus'' to join the wider Resistance, but he declined, not ready to leave his friends. ===Further Resistance work=== {{Quote|I'll be leaving the ''Colossus'' shortly to join you, Norath.''"
"''Great. Get here as soon as you can, Kaz, within two rotations if possible. We'll then rendezvous with the others.''"
"''Understood. I'll leave right away.''"
"''Sending coordinates through an encrypted channel. Ah, I'm excited to have you on board buddy. The Resistance needs all the good pilots we can get.|Kazuda Xiono and Norath Kev|audio=NorathKev-NoPlaceSafe.flac|{{Resistance|No Place Safe}}}} [[File:XionoKevColossusHologram-NoPlaceSafe.png|thumb|left|300px|Norath Kev arranged a rendezvous location near Batuu for Kazuda Xiono.]] Not long after,{{ResistanceDate|2|16}} Doza chose to settle the ''Colossus'' on the Outer Rim planet [[Aeos Prime]], hoping to find peace after fleeing the First Order for several [[Standard month|months]]. However, Xiono became restless and contacted Kev to leave the ''Colossus'' and rejoin the Resistance in its fight against the First Order. The pair discussed their plans over [[hologram]], with the latter noting that he should leave as quickly as possible. Kev then used a secure channel to transmit coordinates for Xiono to meet near the Outer Rim planet [[Batuu]], relaying his excitement for him to join the wider Resistance after they rendezvoused. Xiono departed the ''Colossus'' in his [[Team Fireball|team's]] namesake [[Racing starfighter|racer]], the ''[[Fireball]]'', but was attacked by a [[Unidentified Spider probe droid|First Order probe droid]] not far off Aeos Prime. Though he voiced his regrets about not being able to meet Kev at the rendezvous point in time, Xiono turned back to the planet to warn the ''Colossus'' that the First Order was likely coming. Not long after his warning to Doza, the ''Colossus'' was forced to flee Aeos Prime when the First Order [[Battle of Aeos Prime|attacked]] the world, sending the [[Space station|station]] on the run again. the [[Resistance pilot]] [[Poe Dameron]] met Kev and told the spy about his and Xiono's first [[Mission to rendezvous with the Resistance|meeting]], in which the pilot saved the latter in a [[Starfighter combat|dogfight]] against the First Order. After departing from{{DatapadCite|Port of Call: Varkana|Varkana-GSDatapad.png|gs=yes}} the [[Core Worlds]] planet''[[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge: Treasures from Batuu]]'' [[Chandrila]] later the same [[Standard year|year]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Galactic Starcruiser|''Star Wars'': Galactic Starcruiser]] to [[34 ABY]]. [[Chandrila Star Line]]'s [[MPO-1400 Purgill-class star cruiser|MPO-1400 ''Purgill''-class star cruiser]] ''[[Halcyon]]'' made an unscheduled detour to Varkana to pick up a shipment of blasters for Kev, to be delivered to him on the Outer Rim planet [[Mon Cala]]. The [[Star Cruiser|cruiser's]] port of call schedule, including the Varkana pickup and the delivery on Mon Cala for Kev, was detailed in the voyage's datapad crew notes and indicated that a spaceport [[Aide|attendant]] would have useful intelligence on the endeavor. ===Jade Squadron=== ====Meeting with the aces==== {{Dialogue|Hype Fazon|Wait, wait, wait, wait! Oh, my— Say that again. You're telling me that Kaz almost got thrown out of the academy.|Hugh Sion|Oh, yeah. A couple of times, actually.|Kazuda Xiono|Those were all misunderstandings!|Hype Fazon|Oh, you— You have made my day! I'm gonna buy you a round at Aunt Z's after this.|Kazuda Xiono|Look, I'm really glad that you two are hitting it off, but Norath and I are trying to concentrate.|Norath Kev|I don't mind. It's the most entertainment I've had in weeks.|attr=Hype Fazon, Hugh Sion, Kazuda Xiono, and Norath Kev, while above Dantooine|audio=NorathKev2-RebuildingTheResistance.flac|src=}} [[File:ResistanceDantooineBriefing-RebuildingTheResistance.png|thumb|right|300px|Norath Kev (top left) attended a briefing on the ''Colossus'' before his squadron's mission to Dantooine.]] Kev joined the Resistance's [[Jade Squadron]] under the [[Commanding officer|command]] of Resistance pilot [[Venisa Doza]], but after the [[squadron]] took losses, he, the pilot [[Hugh Sion]], and Doza were all that remained of the group. With her husband Imanuel's agreement, Doza arranged for Jade Squadron to travel to the ''Colossus'' to prepare for their next mission, which was to escort three [[Resistance shuttle|shuttles]] of Resistance recruits off of the [[Blockade of Dantooine|blockaded]] Outer Rim planet [[Dantooine]]. Kev and Sion met with Xiono aboard the station, with the latter Resistance pilot indicating that he{{Databank|hugh-sion|Hugh Sion}} and Xiono had flown [[Kazuda Xiono's team|together]] previously in the [[New Republic Defense Force|New Republic's service]]. Though Xiono bluffed that he had been faring well in a previous skirmish against the First Order, Kev jokingly remarked that Dameron reported a different version of the tale. Upon inquiry, Kev informed Xiono of why Jade Squadron had come to the ''Colossus'', indicating that the Resistance was having difficulty finding recruits to fight the First Order. In the station's [[Aces' Lounge]], Doza hosted a briefing outlining their mission objectives, aided by her astromech droid [[Torch]]'s holographic depiction of Dantooine. The squadron then traveled to the planet for their endeavor alongside the ''Colossus'' [[ace]] pilots Xiono, [[Torra Doza]], and [[Hype Fazon]]. Fazon and Kev were amused when Sion informed them that Xiono had almost gotten kicked out of the [[New Republic Military Academy|New Republic Academy]] despite the latter's protests to drop the topic. ====Firefight over Dantooine==== {{Quote|Norath!''"
"''I see him.|Torra Doza and Norath Kev, defending shuttle two from a TIE fighter|audio=NorathKev3-RebuildingTheResistance.flac|}} [[File:NorathKevDantooine-RebuildingTheResistance.png|thumb|left|300px|Norath Kev flew alongside Jade Squadron and the ''Colossus''{{'s}} ace pilots to defend Resistance shuttles over Dantooine.]] As they approached Dantooine, Kev informed Venisa of an incoming [[Unidentified First Order TIE squadron|First Order TIE fighter squadron]] converging on their location. In the ensuing firefight, Kev and Sion split off and destroyed several [[TIE series|TIE fighters]] together while the others in the escort group divided into pairs and did the same. However, one [[Unidentified First Order TIE fighter pilot (Dantooine)|TIE fighter pilot]] informed Pyre of the attack on the [[blockade]] before their death. As Jade Squadron and the ace pilots began escorting three Resistance shuttles of recruits off Dantooine, the First Order's [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Thunderer]]'' arrived over the planet, and [[Lieutenant]] [[Galek]]'s [[Galek's TIE fighter squadron|squadron]] was deployed to prevent the Resistance recruits from escaping. As the ''Thunderer'' continued to deploy numerous TIE fighters, Venisa ordered Torra, Fazon, and Kev to protect the Resistance shuttles while she, Xiono, and Sion attacked their enemy's ships. Though the group eventually successfully jumped to [[hyperspace]] with two of the shuttles, [[Shuttle two (Resistance)|shuttle two]] was destroyed despite Torra and Kev's efforts to protect it. Afterward, Jade Squadron and the ace pilots rendezvoused with the ''Colossus'', landing with the two remaining shuttles. Imanuel agreed to allow the squadron and recruits to stay on the ''Colossus'' as long as they needed despite his initial agreement only to host them for a few days. The ''Colossus'' then traveled to the [[Barabesh system]] to continue evading the First Order. ====Showdown with the ''Thunderer''==== {{Quote|All right, team, we're going for their engines. Jade Squadron, focus ion bombs on the panels near their thrusters. If we get close enough, we might have a chance at taking them out.|Venisa Doza, to Norath Kev and Hugh Sion|audio=VenisaLeadingJade-TheEscape.flac|}} [[File:JadeSquadronThunderer-TheEscape.png|thumb|right|300px|Norath Kev attacked the ''Thunderer''{{'s}} engines with ion bombs as part of Jade Squadron.]] Not long afterward, Xiono and Yeager attempted to rescue the [[First Order TIE fighter pilot|First Order TIE pilot]] [[Tamara Ryvora]]—who had formerly been the pair's colleague on the ''Colossus''—when she wanted to leave the Order and return home. However, the rescue went awry and the trio were brought aboard the ''Thunderer'', which then headed to the Barabesh system to destroy the ''Colossus''. When Imanuel gathered the station's residents in the [[cantina]] [[Aunt Z's Tavern]], Kev listened to the captain's plea for them to band together to help their friends fight the First Order. After Xiono and Ryvora sent a holographic transmission broadcasted to those in the cantina begging them to flee before the First Order arrived, Kev and the others on the ''Colossus'' felt moved by their loyalty and decided to help them. When the ''Thunderer'' arrived in the Barabesh system, Jade Squadron and the ''Colossus''{{'s}} Ace Squadron began making an [[Battle of Barabesh|attack]] run on the [[Star Destroyer]]. Kev followed Venisa's lead in dropping [[ion bomb]]s on the panels near the ''Thunderer''{{'s}} [[Engine|thrusters]], hoping to damage their engines. Though their initial runs had little effect, Jade Squadron managed to land several successful hits after CB-23 switched off the Star Destroyer's [[Deflector shield|shields]]. [[File:TeamColossus-TheEscape.png|thumb|left|300px|Norath Kev (right) celebrated the ''Thunderer''{{'s}} defeat in Aunt Z's Tavern.]] The chaos caused by the attack allowed Yeager, Xiono, and Ryvora to steal a [[AAL-1971/9.1 Troop Transport|shuttle]] and flee from one of the ''Thunderer''{{'s}} hangar bays. Meanwhile, Kev and his colleagues made one final attack run on the Star Destroyer's engines, causing them to explode and igniting a [[Fire|fiery]] chain reaction throughout the ship, resulting in the ''Thunderer'' imploding from the inside. Kev later boarded the ''Colossus'' and celebrated with the station's residents in Aunt Z's, dubbing themselves [[Team Colossus|Team ''Colossus'']]. Within the year, the Resistance defeated the First Order at the [[Battle of Exegol]], ending their [[The galaxy|galaxy-wide]] war. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|You're— You're too late! I sent a distress signal!''"
"''Why? Are you distressed?''" [Ax Tagrin fires his blaster]
"''2B! I— I warn you. This place will be swarming with Resistance fighters any minute!|Norath Kev and Ax Tagrin|audio=NorathKev4-TheMissingAgent.flac|}} [[File:HughSionKazudaXiono-RebuildingTheResistance.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Norath Kev (left), his squadmate Hugh Sion (center), and Kazuda Xiono greeted each other aboard the ''Colossus''.]] Norath Kev was a man with [[Color|green]] skin and gold [[eye]]s who stood around 1.83 [[meter]]s tall and spoke [[Galactic Basic Standard|Galactic Basic]]. Kev strongly believed in the Resistance's principles and encouraged others to fight to save the [[galaxy]] from the First Order. He was willing to put his life at risk to escort Resistance recruits off Dantooine and fight against the ''Thunderer''. He was able to share camaraderie and work well with others to complete shared objectives, but he also proved capable of working as a solo operative on Varkana. When in dangerous situations, Kev attempted to push himself past his limits after being injured when Tagrin's ship crashed by claiming he could walk when he was unable to. The spy was a brave individual, standing his ground against Tagrin after the bounty hunter destroyed his droid and believing other members of the Resistance would come to save him. However, when Xiono and his colleagues were captured by Tagrin trying to save him, he felt bad about calling for help and getting others entangled in the situation. Despite Tagrin's capture of him putting him in danger, Kev still cared about the parameters of his original mission to track black market contacts, and he was thrilled upon learning that CB-23 had saved his work. Xiono, Yeager, San, and CB-23 were willing to rescue the spy despite the risks of being captured themselves, unwilling to leave a fellow member of the Resistance behind if there was a chance he was still alive. [[File:NorathKazudaRescuing-Breakout.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Norath Kev (left) helped Kazuda Xiono rescue Jarek Yeager and Synara San on Varkana using stormtrooper disguises.]] Kev exchanged several rounds of banter with Xiono on Varkana, not believing in the latter's ability to formulate a rescue plan for San and Yeager. Xiono meanwhile respected that Kev was a fellow Resistance spy but was briefly annoyed when the latter thought his stormtrooper disguise plan would not work. As they evaded [[First Order military|First Order forces]], Kev heavily relied on humor to make light of their dire situation but eventually expressed his gratitude to Xiono when they successfully escaped Varkana. He enjoyed Sion's teasing of Xiono while on the mission to Dantooine regarding the latter almost getting kicked out of the [[New Republic]] Academy. ==Skills and abilities== {{Quote|I was tracking shipments and materials the First Order moves through black market channels.|Norath Kev, to Kazuda Xiono and Jarek Yeager|audio=NorathKev5-TheMissingAgent.flac|}} The spy was a skilled operative who successfully gathered a list of black market First Order contacts and collaborators on Varkana. He was able to avoid First Order detection for some time and proved capable of eventually escaping from capture. The First Order considered Kev dangerous and assigned a high threat level to him on a wanted poster.{{SW|url=breakout-concept-art-gallery|text="Breakout" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 11}} Kev possessed technical skills and was able to send out an encrypted distress signal despite having limited time. Kev was a capable pilot while flying with Jade Squadron for an escort run and also while making attack runs on the ''Thunderer''. ==Equipment== {{Quote|Are you sure this looks okay on me? This thing is two sizes too small.|Norath Kev to Kazuda Xiono, about their stolen stormtrooper disguises|audio=NorathKev4-Breakout.flac|}} [[File:JadeSquadron-TheEscape.png|thumb|right|300px|As part of the Resistance's Jade Squadron, Norath Kev flew a T-70 X-wing starfighter.]] Kev wore a dusty orange [[jumpsuit]] featuring knee patches, pockets, brown side panels, and a light gray strip across the waist. He completed his outfit with a yellow-and-brown [[jacket]] with mud-brown colored sleeves, a pocketed gray-brown [[Clothing|vest]] with lighter gray accenting, and a dark red [[scarf]]. He also donned a pair of gray-and-black [[goggles]] and a set of brown and light gray shoes. While on Varkana, Kev completed his duties for the Resistance using 2BR-NTB, a datapad, and a data rod. Alongside Xiono, Kev stole a set of stormtrooper armor and an [[F-11D blaster rifle]], using them to rescue Yeager and San from the First Order. Though his Varkana datapad was destroyed, the Resistance operative acquired another one capable of transmitting encrypted coordinates, which he used to arrange a rendezvous with Xiono. As part of Jade Squadron, Kev wore an orange [[flight suit]] with a cream-colored [[flak vest]] bearing the [[Rebel Alliance starbird|Resistance's emblem]]. He finished his outfit with a gray [[belt]], cylinders strapped to his uniform in a gray band below the knee, and dark gray [[glove]]s and shoes. While on a mission to Dantooine, Kev flew a [[T-70 X-wing starfighter]] and donned a white [[flight helmet]] with an orange-tinted visor, which featured green stylistic accenting, two green [[victory decal]]s, and a Resistance emblem on the side. ==Behind the scenes== ===Milestones and conception=== {{Quote|Both Norath and Lechee were inspired by early sketches of Duros and Gran characters that were left over from the pre-production work done for the show.|Amy Beth Christenson|{{SW|url=news/buckets-list-extra-the-missing-agent-star-wars-resistance|text=Bucket's List Extra: 6 Fun Facts from "The Missing Agent" - ''Star Wars Resistance''}}}} [[File:NorathKev-ConceptArt2.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Concept design of Norath Kev by Jim Moore]] Norath Kev first appeared in "[[The Missing Agent]]," the twelfth episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]''. Prior to the episode's release on [[December 22]], [[2019]],{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}} Kev's starfighter appeared in a trailer for ''Star Wars Resistance''{{'s}} second season released on [[August 14]] of the same year.{{SWYouTube|JkJtdJKCVto|Star Wars Resistance Season 2 - Trailer (Official)|sw_url=video/disneyxd-season-2-trailer-star-wars-resistance|date=2019-08-14}} He was first identified in a [[StarWars.com]] post announcing the trailer's release, which was posted the same day. The post also revealed the character was voiced by [[Daveed Diggs]], an actor{{SW|url=news/star-wars-resistance-season-2-trailer|text=''Star Wars Resistance'' Season Two Trailer Revealed}} who later voiced the [[human]] [[Crux]] in the ''[[Star Wars: Visions]]'' animated series.{{Visions|The Pit (short film)}} Diggs posted about his character on [[Wikipedia:Twitter|Twitter]] before the episode's airing, including that he liked Kev.{{Twitter|daveeddiggs|status/1208428730760089600|[[Daveed Diggs]]|date=2019-12-21|quote=This guy, Norath Kev, voiced by me, shows up on Star Wars Resistance SUNDAY, DECEMBER 22 at 6pm ET/PT on Disney XD and 10pm ET/PT on Disney Channel! And he's pretty cool if I do say so myself.|archivedate=20200209050530}} The [[2024]] reference book ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' misspells Kev's homeworld of Duro as "Duros." [[Lucasfilm Animation]] artist [[Jim Moore]] made a concept illustration of the character on [[May 4]], [[2018]].{{SW|url=the-missing-agent-concept-art-gallery|text=The Missing Agent Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slides 1 & 5}} Concept artwork pieces of Kev featuring in a wanted poster and wearing First Order stormtrooper armor{{SW|url=breakout-concept-art-gallery|text="Breakout" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 1}} were done by the Lucasfilm Animation artist [[Jason Pichon]] on [[June 7]] and [[June 8]], respectively, of the same year. Moore also created an illustration of Kev in a Resistance flight suit on [[September 8]], 2018.{{SW|url=rebuilding-the-resistance-concept-art-gallery|text="Rebuilding the Resistance" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 10}} ''Star Wars Resistance''{{'s}} art director, [[Amy Beth Christenson]], indicated that Kev and Lechee's designs originated from leftover sketches made during the series' pre-production. ==="Breakout" development=== {{Quote|Norath Kev was just a really fun character where he could have a fun banter with Kaz.|Steven Melching, about writing "Breakout"|audio=NorathKev-StevenMelching.flac|}} [[File:Amleto-ConceptArt.png|thumb|left|200px|Norath Kev and Kazuda Xiono met Amleto (pictured) in earlier drafts of "Breakout," though the latter was ultimately cut from the episode.]] In an earlier version of writer [[Steven Melching]]'s{{WookYouTube|_aRy5PWaiPY|Wookieepedia Interviews - Steven Melching (Part 1)}} script for "[[Breakout]]," the thirteenth episode of ''Star Wars Resistance''{{'s}} second season that aired on [[December 29]], 2019, Kev and Xiono met another spy—the [[Elomin]] [[Amleto]]—instead of encountering Darrb. At one point, Dameron was also included in the plot of "Breakout" and would have been with Kev and Xiono on Varkana. However, Dameron was ultimately cut from the episode due to scheduling conflicts with [[Oscar Isaac]]—Dameron's actor—and because the episode seemed "too crowded." Though visiting Batuu's Black Spire Outpost was discussed during ''Star Wars Resistance''{{'s}} second season,{{YouTube|video=wE0Rh9pe9zY|text=Group Interview with executive producers Athena Portillo, Justin Ridge and Brandon Auman|channel=@briansims8127|name=Brian Sims|date=2019-09-29}} only a mention of Xiono planning to meet Kev near Batuu made it into the finished series. In early production, discussions of having "Breakout" set on Batuu were considered, though ultimately Varkana was created as a new planet to avoid seeming like product placement for the then in-development themed land [[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge|''Star Wars'': Galaxy's Edge]]. Melching felt that Kev was a fun character to write, indicating that the humor in the episode was a way to lighten the mood despite the characters facing dire and dangerous circumstances. ===Concept art gallery=== {{Gallery |source=''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'' |storyboards= |concept= File:NorathKev-ConceptArt2.jpg|Norath Kev, Jim Moore File:NorathKev-ConceptArt3.jpg|Norath Kev's wanted poster, Jason Pichon File:NorathKev-ConceptArt4.jpg|Norath Kev in First Order stormtrooper armor, Jason Pichon File:NorathKev-ConceptArt.jpg|Norath Kev in a Resistance flight suit, Jim Moore |digital= |in-progress= }} ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Norath Kev|imagecat=Images of Norath Kev}} *{{Resistance|The Missing Agent}} {{1st}} *{{Resistance|Breakout}} *{{Resistance|No Place Safe}} {{Hologram}} *{{Resistance|Rebuilding the Resistance}} *{{DatapadCite|Port of Call: Varkana|Varkana-GSDatapad.png|gs=yes}} {{Mo}} *{{Resistance|The Escape (episode)}} ==Sources== {{ScrollBox|content= *{{SWYouTube|JkJtdJKCVto|Star Wars Resistance Season 2 -
